subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Other agents this agent can delegate work to. Tool names and descriptions are generated automatically.

executionLimits.title: Execution limits
executionLimits.description: Runtime caps for the agent's tool loop and subagent delegation.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.description: Custom behavior that runs at agent lifecycle points.

about.greetingHelp: Shown as the agent's opening message when a room starts.

builtInTools.label: Built-in agent tools
builtInTools.help: Include the deployment's default tools in addition to selected toolboxes.
builtInTools.noneAvailable: No built-in tools are available in this deployment.

runBudget.title: Run budget
runBudget.description: Ceilings for a single run. A run can ask for less, never more.

delegation.title: Subagent delegation
delegation.description: How much work this agent can hand off to subagents.

maxTurns.label: Max turns
maxTurns.description: Model calls one run can make in its tool loop. A run still calling tools at the limit stops with an error. Runs request 30 by default, so a higher value only applies when a run asks for more.

maxReflections.label: Max reflections
maxReflections.description: Review rounds after the agent answers, where it checks its work and may call more tools. Runs request none by default, so this only limits runs that ask for reflections.

maxSeconds.label: Max run time
maxSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one run. Blank or 0 means no limit.

maxSubagentDepth.label: Max delegation depth
maxSubagentDepth.description: How many levels deep delegation can go. 1 lets this agent delegate but not its subagents. 0 turns delegation off.

maxSubagentsPerRun.label: Max subagents per run
maxSubagentsPerRun.description: Total subagents one run can start.

maxSpawnsPerTurn.label: Max subagents per turn
maxSpawnsPerTurn.description: Subagents the agent can start from a single model turn, for example to work in parallel.

pixel.label: Pixel
pixel.description: Runs a pixel expression at the lifecycle events you choose.

git_commit.label: Git commit
git_commit.description: Runs git add . && git commit after each agent run.

log_tools.label: Log tool calls
log_tools.description: Logs each tool call's name, params, and duration.

ppt_to_pdf.label: PowerPoint to PDF
ppt_to_pdf.description: Converts the run's output file to PDF afterward.
